metaTitle: Fortnite Item Shop Today – Skins, Emotes & Cosmetic Viewer
metaDescription: Browse today's Fortnite Item Shop with live V-Bucks prices, full outfit sets, style variants, emote dance videos, and a searchable catalog of every cosmetic — including newly added and incoming items.
hero: The free Fortnite cosmetic browser for today's shop, full outfit sets, emote dance videos, style variants, and every skin in the catalog — including newly added and incoming items.
clickHint: Click any outfit, emote, or cosmetic for the full set, V-Bucks price (if in shop), styles, and dance/emote video when available.

wishlist.description: Star skins in the shop, New, or catalog. Starred items that return after leaving get a Back badge. Prices roll into the V-Bucks calculator.
wishlist.empty: Nothing starred yet. Open today's shop and tap the star on a skin.
wishlist.vbucksLink: Add these to the V-Bucks calculator
